/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrderList : Order List(Detail) */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM (
SELECT COUNT(A.OD_JOB_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT ,SUM(ISNULL(A.PIECES,0)) OVER() AS SUM_PIECES ,SUM(ISNULL(A.GWT,0)) OVER() AS SUM_GWT ,SUM(ISNULL(A.CBM,0)) OVER() AS SUM_CBM ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS SIMPLE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'N' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS GENERAL_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'B' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS EXCLUDE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'E' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS IMPLEMENTATION_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.INSPECTION_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS SUM_INSPECTION ,COUNT(CASE A.DROP_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS SUM_DROP FROM(
SELECT ad.LAST_POD_STATUS ,od.OD_JOB_NO
,od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerUpperLev} AS UPPER_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerUpperLev}) AS UPPER_CUS_NAME
,NULL AS UPPER_CUS_CODE ,NULL AS UPPER_CUS_NAME
,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS UPPER_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS UPPER_CUS_NAME
,od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerLowLev} AS LOW_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerLowLev}) AS LOW_CUS_NAME
,NULL AS LOW_CUS_CODE ,NULL AS LOW_CUS_NAME
,od.CUST_CODE_LV2 AS LOW_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS LOW_CUS_NAME
,od.PO_DATE
,(SELECT TOP 1 POD.POD_DATE from TB_ECM_POD_04 POD WHERE POD.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD.POD_STATUS = 'ECM340' ) AS POD_DATE_CHK
,od.PO_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,od.MRN ,od.SHIPPER_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,(CASE WHEN ad.ZIPCODE_ERROR_YN = 'Y' THEN '오류' END) AS ZIPCODE_ERROR_YN ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.CURRENCY_CODE ,od.EXCHANGE_RATE ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.AMOUNT_USD ,od.PIECES_REAL ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.CBM ,od.GWT_LBS ,ad.PRINT_YN ,ad.PRINT_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.ORIG_COUNTRY ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.OB_DATE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.FTA_YN ,od.FTA_REMARKS ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_ERROR ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,ad.DROP_YN ,ad.XRAY_YN ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.CONSOL_YN ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE ,od.REMARKS ,od.DELIVERY_NOTE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'Y' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS CHK1 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSOL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS >= 'ECM030' THEN 'Y' END AS CHK2 ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NM ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,ad.SMS_INFORM_YN ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), DATEADD(hh, -9, ad.SMS_INFORM_DATE), 120) AS SMS_INFORM_DATE ,ad.SMS_INFORM_RES_YN ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), DATEADD(hh, -9, ad.SMS_INFORM_RES_DATE), 120) AS SMS_INFORM_RES_DATE ,ad.CARRYIN_DATE ,ad.CARRYOUT_DATE
,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE
,od.DELIVERY_CODE
,od.CD_TYPE + ' ' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' AND CODE = od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE + ' ' +(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE + ' ' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE' AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE) AS ECM_TYPE ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY + ' ' + (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY' AND CODE = ad.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY) AS CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY
,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY
,od.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'DROP_CODE' AND CODE = ad.DROP_CODE) AS DROP_REASON ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,od.DELIVERY_NAME_CHANGED ,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.AGENT_NAME ,od.SELLER_REG_NO ,od.SELLER_NAME ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO ,od.SALES_BROKER_NAME ,od.TARIFF_REMARKS ,ad.DELIVERY_STATUS ,ad.CLEARANCE_RECEIPT_DATE ,ad.CLEARANCE_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 pod WHERE pod.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM251' ) AS CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_DATE ,ad.DELIVERY_RECV_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM361' ) AS PICKUP_DATE ,ad.DELIVERY_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM400' ) AS UNDELIVERY_DATE ,( SELECT REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM400' ) AS UNDELIVERY_REMARKS ,STUFF((SELECT ',' + PO_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_PO_INFO WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')) ,1 ,1, '') AS PO_NO_LIST ,od.MULTI_YN
,COUNT(od.OD_JOB_NO) OVER() AS SUM_COUNT
,COUNT(od.OD_JOB_NO) OVER() AS TOTAL ,(SELECT USER_LOGIN_ID FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME
,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.CBM ,od.CD_TYPE ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,ad.DROP_YN
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS CUSTOMS_ID
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ,od.CUSTOMS_ID
,od.CONSIGNEE_FIRST_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_LAST_NAME ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_END_DATE ,ad.CUSTOMS_ID_START_DATE
,od.SHIPMENT_BOX_ID ,ad.RETURN_REQUEST_ID ,ad.RETURN_REQ_DATE ,ad.RETURN_DELIVERY_CODE ,od.RETURN_YN ,ad.RETURN_REG_DATE ,ad.RETURN_END_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM530' ) AS RETURN_START_DATE ,od.RETURN_DELIVERY_NO
,od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE ,od.ORDER_NAME ,od.ECM_YN ,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI teom WHERE teom.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) as multiCnt FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON multi.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
AND ad.LAST_POD_STATUS <> 'ECM002'
) A
) X
) SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS NUM FROM Main_CTE
OFFSET ${startNum} ROWS FETCH NEXT ${pageSize} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: /* OrderCustomerMapper.updateSumOrder : Order 수량 중량 볼륨 금액 업데이트 */ UPDATE od SET od.PIECES = A.PIECES ,od.GWT = A.GWT ,od.GWT_LBS = ROUND(ISNULL(A.GWT,0) * 2.20462262,ROUND(${wtDecimalAir},2),0) ,od.VWT = A.VWT ,od.CBM = CASE WHEN od.BOUND = 'AIR' THEN A.VWT ELSE od.CBM END ,od.CURRENCY_CODE = A.CURRENCY_CODE ,od.AMOUNT_CUR = A.AMOUNT ,UPDATE_USER_ID = #{updateUserId} ,UPDATE_DATE_TIME = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,SUM(item.PIECES) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS PIECES ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY od.OD_JOB_NO,item.SEQ_NO_ID ) AS ROW_NUM ,SUM(ISNULL(item.GWT,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS GWT ,SUM(ISNULL(item.VWT,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS VWT ,item.CURRENCY_CODE ,SUM(item.AMOUNT) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS AMOUNT FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ITEM item ON od.OD_JOB_NO = item.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ) INFO WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 ) A ON A.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrder : Order 조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.PO_NO ,od.PO_DATE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT ((SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' ),'[',CONVERT(CHAR(16),odAdd.LAST_POD_DATE, 21),']') END AS LAST_POD_STATUS ,od.OB_DATE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE ,od.PIECES ,od.PIECES_REAL ,od.GWT ,od.VWT ,od.CBM ,od.GWT_LBS ,od.CURRENCY_CODE ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.AMOUNT_CUR ,od.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,odAdd.XRAY_YN ,odAdd.DROP_YN ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.SHIPPER_STREET ,od.SHIPPER_PLACE ,od.SHIPPER_STATE_CODE ,od.SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE ,od.URL ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,od.CONSIGNEE_STREET ,od.CONSIGNEE_PLACE ,od.CONSIGNEE_STATE_CODE ,od.CONSIGNEE_COUNTRY_CODE ,od.ORIG_COUNTRY ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE ,od.DELIVERY_CODE ,od.DELIVERY_NAME ,od.CB_CODE ,od.CB_NAME ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE ,od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,od.FTA_YN ,od.FTA_REMARKS ,od.REMARKS ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.AGENT_NAME ,od.SELLER_REG_NO ,od.SELLER_NAME ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO ,od.SALES_BROKER_NAME ,od.DIM_WIDTH ,od.DIM_LENGTH ,od.DIM_HEIGHT ,od.MULTI_YN ,od.CONSOL_YN ,od.FINISH_YN ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(odAdd.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') NOT IN ('', 'ERROR') THEN 'Y' END AS SIMPLE_EDI_SEND_YN ,od.REGISTER_USER_ID ,od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,od.UPDATE_USER_ID ,od.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT STUFF((SELECT ',' + DELIVERY_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '')) AS MULTI_DELIVERY_NO ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME
,mod.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE ,od.DELIVERY_NOTE
,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 as UPPER_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) as UPPER_CUS_NAME ,od.CUST_CODE_LV2 as LOW_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV2) as LOW_CUS_NAME
,od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerUpperLev} as UPPER_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerUpperLev}) as UPPER_CUS_NAME
,NULL AS UPPER_CUS_CODE ,NULL AS UPPER_CUS_NAME
,od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerLowLev} as LOW_CUS_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${loginCustomerLowLev}) as LOW_CUS_NAME
,NULL as LOW_CUS_CODE ,NULL as LOW_CUS_NAME
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS CUSTOMS_ID
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ,od.CUSTOMS_ID
,odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_START_DATE ,odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_END_DATE ,od.CONSIGNEE_LAST_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_FIRST_NAME ,od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE ,od.FORWARD_AGENT_NAME ,od.ORDER_NAME ,od.ORDER_TEL ,od.ORDER_ACCOUNT ,od.ECM_YN ,od.DEST_DELIVERY_NO
,od.FORWARD_AGENT_CODE ,od.FORWARD_AGENT_NAME ,od.ORDER_NAME ,od.ORDER_TEL ,od.ORDER_ACCOUNT ,od.ECM_YN
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON mod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrderItem : Order Item */ SELECT OD_JOB_NO ,SEQ_NO_ID ,HS_CODE ,ORIGIN_COUNTRY ,DETAIL_ITEM_NAME ,DETAIL_ITEM_NAME_LOC ,PIECES ,UNIT_PIECES ,CURRENCY_CODE ,UNIT_PRICE ,AMOUNT ,GWT ,VWT ,DIM_WIDTH ,DIM_LENGTH ,DIM_HEIGHT ,ECM_URL ,BRAND ,REMARKS ,CUSTOMS_ID ,CUSTOMS_TEMP_NO ,CATEGORY_NAME_1 ,CATEGORY_NAME_2 ,CATEGORY_NAME_3 ,CATEGORY_NAME_4 ,CATEGORY_NAME_5 ,CATEGORY_NAME_6 ,CATEGORY_NAME_7 ,CATEGORY_NAME_8 ,CATEGORY_NAME_9 ,OPTION_NAME ,SELLER_NAME ,SELLER_ID ,SELLER_CODE ,ITEM_MAF_NAME ,ITEM_MAF_MODEL_NO ,ITEM_BRAND_NAME ,ITEM_ID ,ORDER_NO ,FORMAT(ORDER_END_DATETIME, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') AS ORDER_END_DATETIME FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY SEQ_NO_ID

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrderMulti : Order 멀티(중량)화물 조회 */ SELECT mti.DELIVERY_NO ,mti.DELIVERY_CODE ,mti.CUSTOMER_CODE ,mti.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED ,mti.PAYMENT_GUBN ,mti.DELIVERY_FEE ,mti.PIECES ,mti.DIM_WIDTH ,mti.DIM_LENGTH ,mti.DIM_HEIGHT ,mti.VWT ,mti.RECIPIENT_NAME ,mti.SEQ_NO_ID ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.RECEIPT_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS RECEIPT_DATE ,mti.REMARKS ,mti.REGISTER_USER_ID ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), mti.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, 20) AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,mti.DELIVERER_USER_ID ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.DELIVERY_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS DELIVERY_DATE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = mti.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND USER_ID = mti.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND USER_ID = mti.DELIVERER_USER_ID) AS DELIVERER_USER_NAME ,mti.RETURN_DELIVERY_NO ,mti.RETURN_REQUEST_ID ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.RETURN_REQ_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS RETURN_REQ_DATE ,mti.RETURN_DELIVERY_CODE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.RETURN_END_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS RETURN_END_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.RETURN_REG_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS RETURN_REG_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.RETURN_DLV_REQ_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS RETURN_DLV_REQ_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.DELIVERY_REG_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS DELIVERY_REG_DATE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mti.DELIVERY_END_DATE, ${dateFormat}) AS DELIVERY_END_DATE ,mti.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC_M ,mti.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC_M ,mti.CONSIGNEE_TEL_M ,mti.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE_M FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mti WHERE mti.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY mti.SEQ_NO_ID

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrderSub : Order Sub */ SELECT OD_JOB_NO ,DETAIL_ITEM_NAME ,PIECES ,CURRENCY_CODE ,GWT ,VWT ,AMOUNT_LOC AS AMOUNT ,CASE WHEN ITEM_CNT = 1 THEN UNIT_PIECES END UNIT_PIECES ,CASE WHEN ITEM_CNT = 1 THEN UNIT_PRICE END UNIT_PRICE ,CASE WHEN ITEM_CNT = 1 THEN ECM_URL END ECM_URL ,CASE WHEN ITEM_CNT = 1 THEN BRAND END BRAND FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS DETAIL_ITEM_NAME ,SUM(item.PIECES) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS PIECES ,COUNT(1) OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS ITEM_CNT ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY od.OD_JOB_NO,item.SEQ_NO_ID ) AS ROW_NUM ,od.CURRENCY_CODE ,item.UNIT_PIECES ,item.UNIT_PRICE ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.GWT ,od.VWT ,item.ECM_URL ,item.BRAND FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ITEM item ON od.OD_JOB_NO = item.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.PARENT_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ) OD WHERE ROW_NUM = 1

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectCusLvl : Order Customer level 추출 */ WITH tree_query AS ( SELECT 'O' AS GUBUN ,cus.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE ,cus.CUSTOMER_CODE ,cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus ON usr.ENT_CODE = cus.ENT_CODE AND usr.CUSTOMER_CODE = cus.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE usr.ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND usr.USER_ID = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT '' AS GUBUN ,B.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE ,B.CUSTOMER_CODE ,B.CUSTOMER_LEVEL FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER B, tree_query C WHERE B.CUSTOMER_CODE = C.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE AND ISNULL(C.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE,'') != '' AND ISNULL(B.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE,'') != B.CUSTOMER_CODE )
SELECT MAX(CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_CODE_LV2 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV3) AS CUST_CODE_LV3 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV4) AS CUST_CODE_LV4 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV5) AS CUST_CODE_LV5 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV6) AS CUST_CODE_LV6 ,MAX(CUST_CODE_LV7) AS CUST_CODE_LV7 ,MAX(USER_CUSTOMER_CODE) AS USER_CUSTOMER_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 1 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV1 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 2 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV2 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 3 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV3 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 4 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV4 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 5 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV5 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 6 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV6 ,CASE WHEN CUSTOMER_LEVEL = 7 THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END CUST_CODE_LV7 ,CASE WHEN GUBUN = 'O' THEN CUSTOMER_CODE END USER_CUSTOMER_CODE FROM tree_query ) LV

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectUserInfo : user 거래처 정보 */ SELECT cus.CUSTOMER_CODE ,cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL,'') = '' THEN NULL WHEN cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL = '1' THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(INT,cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL)-1) END UPPER_LEVEL ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL,'') = '' THEN NULL WHEN cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL = '7' THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(INT,cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL)+1) END LOW_LEVEL FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus ON usr.ENT_CODE = cus.ENT_CODE AND usr.CUSTOMER_CODE = cus.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE usr.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND usr.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* OrderCustomerMapper.selectOrderCustomerChkList : 오더저장체크 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, '') AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,od.HBL_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
